last_episode_to_air.name: Terminal
last_episode_to_air.overview: With the handover imminent, Sam is prepared to put his life on the line to save Marsha—and expose the truth.

tmdb.name: Hijack
tmdb.overview: Expert negotiator Sam Nelson is in for the ride of his life—and so is everyone on board with him—after a group of hijackers take control. Sam will try every move in his playbook to take them down...as the stakes grow higher by the second.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In the second season, a Berlin underground train and its commuters are taken hostage, while authorities scramble to save hundreds of lives. Sam Nelson is at the heart of the crisis on board, where one wrong decision could spell disaster.

tmdb.tagline: Who can you trust when it's all on the line?

results.overview:
Retirement has given Mr Rose the time not only to cultivate a cottage garden in Eastbourne but also to write his memoirs.

And it’s the impending publication of those memoirs that brings a number of figures crawling out of the woodwork and back into his life: criminals and former colleagues alike, who know that his vast personal library of case files holds a wealth of incriminating detail.
results.name: Mr. Rose

results.overview: A young girl flees from her homeland to start over with her mother. But when a crime ring ruins her life, she adopts a new identity to take revenge.
results.name: Thicha

results.overview: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.
results.name: I Will Find You

results.overview: Through the lens of two men whose lives are far more connected than they realize, explore the cracks of small-town America in the wake of discovering a serial killer among them.
results.name: Silent River

results.overview: Six months ago, Hikaru vanished for a week. Now, as his best friend Yoshiki senses something amiss and confronts him, the harrowing truth emerges.
results.name: The Summer Hikaru Died

results.overview: Mukut, a peace-loving girl from a humble background, is fascinated by Goddess Durga. She draws energy from various forms of the goddess to spread happiness and fight the evils of society.
results.name: Mukut

results.overview: Flight attendant Cassandra Bowden wakes in her hotel room hungover from the night before in Dubai with a dead body lying next to her. Afraid to call the police, she continues her morning as if nothing happened. In New York, she is met by FBI agents who question her about her recent layover in Bangkok. Still unable to piece the night together, she begins to wonder if she could be the killer.
results.name: The Flight Attendant

results.overview: The story of a middle-class man who works for a special cell of the National Investigation Agency. While he tries to protect the nation from terrorists, he also has to protect his family from the impact of his secretive, high-pressure, and low paying job.
results.name: The Family Man

results.overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.
results.name: Squid Game

results.overview: Abandoned as a child, Aleena grows up longing for love. Will life ever lead her back to her lost parents and the happiness she dreams of?
results.name: Mazha Thorum Munpe

results.overview: While protecting a bride-to-be, Yue Ziyuan discovers her growing feelings for the groom, Yang Xiao. Forced to work together to revive the merchant roads and solve their parents’ murders, the two navigate danger, duty, and an unexpected romance.
results.name: Maid Escort

results.overview: A flight attendant's dream of becoming a pilot sparks a high-stakes love triangle between an airline heir and a guilt-ridden mechanic with a mysterious past.
results.name: New Horizon

results.overview: Appearances can be deceptive and so is Jhanvi, the perfect bahu of the Mittal household. Fuelled by revenge, she's planning a sinister future for her 'beloved' in-laws. No one knows why?
results.name: Ek Bhram - Sarvagun Sampanna

results.overview: When soldier Shaun Emery's conviction for a murder in Afghanistan is overturned due to flawed video evidence, he returns to life as a free man with his young daughter. But when damning CCTV footage from a night out in London comes to light, Shaun's life takes a shocking turn and he must soon fight for his freedom once again.
results.name: The Capture

results.overview: The story of how Detective Superintendent Steve Fulcher deliberately breached police procedure and protocol to catch a killer, a decision that ultimately cost him his career and reputation.
results.name: A Confession

results.overview: The resourceful protagonist Zhang Yi (Liang Dawei) sought medical expenses for the weak and sick sister Zhang Ying (Jinmeng Yangzi), and entered the college with the purpose of finding the legendary treasure of the heavens, and met the Mohist school here. The descendant of Duanmuzheng (Zhang Ruihan), the sultry and human librarian Nantang Prince Li Yuyu (Li Wenhan), the melancholy divination of the divination girl Cui Jialuo (Zhang Xixi) and the innocent and lively Korean Princess Wang Enzhu (Ai Xiaoqi).
results.name: My Naughty Classmates

results.overview: Takashi Oshii is a detective with excellent reasoning power. Unfortunately, he usually misses the criminal in front of him and other detectives get recognition for the capture. He is transferred to the Utobashi Police Station. Takashi Oshii goes to a record company CEO's house. The CEO's third son was burned to death. The police are set to conclude that his death was an accident, but Takashi Oshii thinks otherwise. Takashi Oshii begins to investigate.
results.name: So Close! Detective Oshii

results.overview: Oslo detectives Max  Sørensen and Sander Holm are called in to investigate after four young immigrant boys are found dead in an empty swimming pool. Bizarre twists in the case brings the detectives face to face with both their own demons and a dark sequence of increasingly inexplicable events.
results.name: Seizure

results.overview: The story unfolds as Zhou Na, a modern-day mystery novelist, finds herself serendipitously transported to ancient Yan City, where she becomes the fiancée of County Magistrate Guo Zijie. Together, they repeatedly solve bizarre cases. As their mutual affection deepens and their bond grows stronger, a sinister conspiracy involving life and death silently emerges...
results.name: Cao Xuanxuan's Love Journey

results.overview: Five aspiring lawyers are aiming for the top - but behind the scenes they're a mess of love, drugs and excess.
results.name: This Life

omdb.Title: Hijack
omdb.Actors: Idris Elba, Max Beesley, Christine Adams
omdb.Plot: A tense thriller (told in real time) that follows the journey of a hijacked plane as it makes its way to London over a seven-hour flight, while authorities on the ground scramble for answers. Sam Nelson (Elba) is an accomplished negotiator in the business world, who needs to step up and use all his guile to try and save the lives of the passengers -- but, his high-risk strategy could be his undoing.
omdb.Awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 3 wins & 10 nominations total
